svg.text: Figure 1 - Structural metrics by topology and population size

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Graph-only measurements. 5 topologies x 5 sizes x 5 seeds = 125 graphs, all matched at mean degree 4 (exactly 2N edges) and all connected. Points are seed means; error bars are +/-1 sample SD (ddof=1, n=5). Not an LLM or task-performance result.
